ws_policy.title: Fiscal Policy
values: Flag departments that have used more than 80% of their effective annual budget by the current month
Departments with Budget Type Supplemental add the Supplemental Amount to Annual Budget for effective total

Departments with Start Date in the current fiscal year get pro-rated budget: Annual Budget * (remaining months from start / 12). Remaining months means the number of months from the Start Date month through December, inclusive. For example, a Start Date of 2026-03-01 means 10 remaining months (Mar through Dec).
Departments with Notes containing One-time approved overage are exempt from alerts
Departments with Budget Status Frozen are under executive review - do not alert, handled separately

Sum all monthly columns up to and including the current month (February = Jan + Feb). This applies to ALL departments regardless of Start Date. Pro-rated budget only affects the budget cap, not the YTD spending total.
